hypothesis: A one-second causal CV-Markov mean prediction improves distributed bistatic assignment under L4 without the clean-regime regression of short fixed commitment.

confirmation_protocol.exclusions: formal test split, quarantined/development-excluded seeds, and all prior L4 calibration/holdout seeds

acceptance.SCORE: candidate L4 worst mean delta must be positive
acceptance.WEAK3: candidate L4 weak3 mean delta must be non-negative
acceptance.TAIL: candidate L4 worst minimum must not decrease
acceptance.QOS: candidate L4 QoS rate must not decrease
acceptance.L0_GUARD: four-seed L0 worst mean delta must be at least -0.01
acceptance.RESOURCE: bits/frame, delivery rate and sensing-power cap must remain unchanged

confirmation_results.decision: Reject endpoint-mean H10 as a promoted algorithm. Preserve the default-off predictor for reproducibility and test a path-integrated uncertainty-aware score as a distinct hypothesis.
